channel.title: smollerGraph | Building smollerGraph: A Graph Database from Scratch
channel.description: A small graph database built from scratch in C++, from the bytes on disk to the query language, heading towards a knowledge graph.

item.title: Episode 12: Shortest paths in a graph database
item.description: Shortest paths in smollerGraph, with a breadth-first search that keeps each node's parent, then two of them that meet in the middle, shortestPath in Cypher as Neo4j writes it, and a path drawn on the page.

item.title: Episode 11: Reverse traversal and query planning
item.description: Relationships followed both ways in smollerGraph, with labels and types as tokens to make room for a second chain, Cypher that points left, plans that start from a name, and a fair benchmark in Cypher.

item.title: Episode 10: Canvas vs SVG: drawing a Wikidata graph
item.description: Mammals and birds from Wikidata in smollerGraph, with room in its records for real names and a label, and a page that draws what a query returns on a canvas, measured against SVG.

item.title: Episode 9: Property graph storage and WHERE in C++
item.description: Properties for smollerGraph's nodes and relationships, in a chain of records on disk, loaded from facts, asked about with WHERE, and shown in the inspector.

item.title: Episode 8: Deploying a graph database to a VPS with Docker
item.description: smollerGraph on a VPS, sent over SSH and run with Docker Compose, with Caddy serving the page in front of the database.

item.title: Episode 7: Writing a Cypher query parser and planner in C++
item.description: A subset of Cypher for smollerGraph, from tokens to a parser, a plan and its rows, in sg query and in the UI.

item.title: Episode 6: B+ tree index in C++: finding a node by name
item.description: An index on names for smollerGraph, a B+ tree in pages through the buffer pool, so opening a graph no longer reads each node.

item.title: Episode 5: Database buffer pool in C++: keeping pages in memory
item.description: A buffer pool for smollerGraph, with frames, a page table, pins, dirty pages and the clock, and what it does to a million relationships.

item.title: Episode 4: Graph visualization in the browser with D3.js
item.description: cpplint, clang-tidy and Abseil's Status for smollerGraph, then a UI, with sg serve answering HTTP and a page that draws the graph with D3, walks it a hop at a time, and shows each node's record on disk.

item.title: Episode 3: Graph database benchmark: Neo4j vs Kùzu
item.description: A first benchmark on a million relationships, with the same two-hop question asked of smollerGraph, Neo4j and Kùzu.

item.title: Episode 2: Graph database in C++: pages on disk
item.description: The graph moves from memory into files of 4 KiB pages, with fixed-size records for nodes and relationships, so it outlives the program.

item.title: Episode 1: How graph databases work: Neo4j and Kùzu
item.description: Before we build one in C++, why graphs, where the series is heading, and how Neo4j and Kùzu store a graph and run a query.
